messages:
Ben: Prospect ITRisk emailed: they want our SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter covering Jan 2026. They also attached a short CAIQ and asked if we can pre-fill answers before NDA. Procurement says no docs/no signatures = no PO.
Lina: Don't share SOC2 pre-NDA. We can do: redacted SOC2 executive summary + completed non-confidential CAIQ QA today. @Fitz can you fill CAIQ items that are public?
Fitz: Yes I can. I'll mark anything that references infra ARNs or customer data as "requires NDA". For CAIQ control "Data Retention" I'll note: "Embedding payloads are retained for up to 30 days by default; can be configured per customer contract."
Kara: Also confirm auditor and period: Auditor: Clearview LLP, period ended 2025-12-31. Add that to the exec summary.
Ben: Procurement specifically asked for proof of key management. Can we include KMS rotation cadence and HSM mention without full configs?
Fitz: Put: "Customer data encryption at rest using AWS KMS; keys rotated quarterly. Critical keys stored in HSM-backed KMS. Access limited to ops with MFA and recorded in audit logs."
LegalBot: Reminder: Bridge letters are allowed but must go through Legal intake. Submit Legal Request with customer legal entity, attestation period, and approver. Use template: https://internal/legal-requests.
Lina: Draft bridge letter (two sentences):

Ben: paste?
Lina: "To whom it may concern,

Redwood Inference attests that there have been no material changes to the controls described in our SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending December 31, 2025, through the attestation date of January 31, 2026. This letter is provided for vendor risk review only and does not replace the audited SOC 2 report. Evidence access requires a signed mutual NDA and approval from Legal; read-only links will be provided and logged."
Kara: Can we add a line: "For additional assurance, we offer a 15-min security walkthrough with our engineering/security lead"?
Ben: Yes please, that may unblock them. Add: "We are available for a 15-minute security call to review controls."
Fitz: I'll complete the CAIQ and flag three items as NDA-only: vulnerability scan reports, SOC evidence packages, and penetration test reports.
ProcurementBot: Procurement note: If you can send the redacted exec summary + filled CAIQ + bridge letter within 24h, we'll expedite PO review.
Ben: OK I'm sending redacted exec summary + CAIQ + draft bridge to Prospect legal now and CC'ing Procurement. Filing Legal Request for bridge letter sign-off. Keep me posted on NDA status.
Lina: If they push for raw evidence before NDA, escalate to me and Legal.
LegalBot: Also note: use the standard mutual NDA; one-way NDAs require commercial approval.
Fitz: For stage: I'll add a short note in CAIQ answer: "See NDA for evidence access" where appropriate.
Ben: Thanks all. If they accept the bridge + CAIQ we'll schedule the 15-min walkthrough.
